programme.title: South Park: Korkad, bortskämd hora-leksaken
programme.desc: Paris Hilton öppnar en butik i South Park och fördärvar samtidigt flickornas moral. Endast Wendy håller fast vid gamla normer.

programme.title: South Park: Små brottsförebyggare

programme.title: South Park: Den magiska busken

programme.title: South Park: Dansar med smurfar
programme.desc: Cartman blir utnämnd till att läsa upp morgonnyheterna i högtalarna på South Park Elementary.

programme.title: South Park: Endast medlemmar
programme.desc: Den tillträdande presidenten besöker sin hemstad.

programme.title: South Park: Döda barn

programme.desc: A talented host and designer of a high-end renovation television show is forced to change her show format to include life makeovers as well after her ratings dip. However, when she tries to upscale the handsome and down-to-Earth subject of her first episode, she must choose between chasing ratings or following her heart.

programme.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
programme.desc: An urbane fox cannot resist returning to his farm raiding ways and then must help his community survive the farmers' retaliation.

programme.desc: Hardworking & optimistic television producer, Kelly, doesn’t have time for love. Along with her mentor Amanda, Kelly dives into another season of the Little Gourmet, a kids cooking show, when hot-headed Chef Stephen is dropped into Kelly’s life as a last minute replacement host. As the two struggle to make peace and a successful show, they realize they have a lot more in common than they thought – a love of food, the kids they encounter & each other.

programme.title: Planning on Forever
programme.desc: Emma is an events planner who doesn't have time for love, until her sister reveals that her wedding is in six weeks. Emma agrees to step in and plan it herself with the help of Liam, who Emma had a disastrous blind date with years ago.

programme.title: Boulevard: Boulevard
programme.desc: En tråkig bankman (Robin Williams) utmanas när han oväntat tar en ny riktning i livet och väljer kärleken.

programme.title: Paterson
programme.desc: Paterson (Adam Driver) är busschaufför i staden Paterson, New Jersey. Varje dag kör han sin dagliga rutt under vilken han observerar staden när den flimrar förbi genom vindrutan och lyssnar samtidigt på fragment av passagerarnas konversationer.

programme.title: Tully
programme.desc: En ny dramakomedi från teamet bakom Juno med Charlize Theron i huvudrollen som Marlo.

programme.title: Big Momma's House 2
programme.desc: Big Momma är tillbaka! Rikets säkerhet är hotad och FBI-agenten Malcolm Turner måste återigen ikläda sig rollen som Big Momma.

programme.title: Skurkar och banditer
programme.desc: Tony Roma är alla tiders halaste gigolo specialiserad på att knycka förmögna hemmafruars diamanter. Till slut kopplas den hemliga polisen Parker in för att ta fast den lille skojaren.

programme.title: Ghost Rider - Spirit Of Vengeance
programme.desc: Johnny Blaze kämpar alltjämt mot sin förbannelse som djävulens prisjägare. Och när en hemlig religiös sekt vill anlita hans tjänster, känner han sig inte redo att ännu en gång ikläda sig Ghost Riders brinnande krafter och makt. Men kanske är detta den sista möjligheten att göra sig fri.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Den italienska westernstjärnan Bud Spencer (hans riktiga namn är Carlo Pedersoli) spelar en godhjärtad men järnnävad bananodlare som bor i en liten djungelby.

programme.title: Ettor & Nollor - Part 1
programme.desc: FBI och Interpol får nys om en stor kreditkortshärva och pundaren Sebbe plockas in som misstänkt.

programme.title: On The Edge
programme.desc: Illegal streetracing, alkohol och kärlek för stunden är alltsammans saker som håller intresset vid liv för ett rastlöst och adrenalinhungrigt kompisgäng.

programme.title: Tatjana
programme.desc: Valto och Reino ger sig av på bilfärd och längs vägen plockar de upp Tatjana och Klaudia. Resan går genom ett Finland som inte påverkats av Nokia eller EU utan förblivit urfinskt. Sin vana trogen levererar Kaurismäki en film utan onödig dialog.

programme.title: Shoo Bre
programme.desc: Trots att Oscar och Elias växer upp i samma stökiga kvarter ser deras liv helt olika ut. De ska snart sluta i skolan och ser båda fram emot att få forma sin egen framtid. Men inget blir som de trodde. Allt går åt helvete.

programme.title: Borkmanns Punkt
programme.desc: Där ute någonstans gömmer sig en mördare som gradvis känner sig mer och mer säker. Kaalbringen, en liten europeisk kuststad,är en stad i skräck. Maardam likaså. På kort tid har de två städerna drabbatsav två brutala mord. När och var ska ”Halshuggaren” slå till igen?

programme.title: The Duchess
programme.desc: En krönika över 1700-talsaristokraten Georgiana, hertiginna av Devonshire, som vördades för sitt extravaganta politiska och personliga liv.

programme.title: Ljus i skymningen (Lights in the Dusk)
programme.desc: Aki Kaurismäkis film om nattvakten Koistinen som förlorar jobbet, friheten och drömmarna. Men till sist skönjer han en strimma hopp.

programme.desc: Rosso är berättelsen om den sicilianska lönnmördaren Giancarlo Rosso, som har kommit till Finland för att leta efter sitt nästa mål, som råkar vara hans älskade Marja. Oväntat får Rosso hjälp med spårningen av Marjas bror Martti, trots att de inte ens delar ett gemensamt språk.

programme.title: Jimmy P.

programme.title: Sommersby
programme.desc: Efter sex år av inbördeskrig återvänder en snällare, mer omtänksam sydstatssoldat till sin gård och hustrun som trodde att han var död. En besviken friare avslöjar att soldaten är en bedragare, och att den riktiga Sommersby är efterlyst för mord.

programme.title: My Old Lady
programme.desc: Den utfattige New York-bon Mathias ärver en lägenhet i Paris av sin far som han inte haft någon kontakt med. När han anländer till staden finner han till sin förvåning att en äldre, sofistikerad dam, Mathilde, och hennes mycket beskyddande dotter bor i våningen.

programme.desc: One of the looniest pictures to come along in some time! STIR CRAZY teams two of the most brilliant and zany comic performers today: Richard Pryor and Gene Wilder. programme.title: The Therapy Crouch - You May As Well Move In Then
programme.desc: On this week’s episode, Pete provides a lesson on exactly how not to ask the love of your life to move in with you. Learn more about Peter’s revolutionary invention, ‘The Squat Box’ and why you should never leave your home movie collection lying around when your future wife and mother-in-law are coming round for tea. From Pet Detectives to interior design clashes, no stone is left unturned on The Therapy Crouch.

programme.title: The Therapy Crouch - Will You Marry Me?
programme.desc: This week, Abbey and Peter provide a schooling session on how to nail the perfect proposal (spoiler: It does not involve chemtrails) Weekly Whine club is also back, with Abbey and Peter going a bit more upmarket to celebrate the roaring success that is The Therapy Crouch! We learn why you can't trust Abbey to keep a clean car and how Peter is considering taking up a career modelling fake tan. And, as always, Agony Ab is on hand to give you the listener some advice for your tricky relationship problems. Enjoy!

programme.title: The Therapy Crouch - I WANT BONO
programme.desc: On today’s episode, Abbey and Peter shed light on all the things they have in common, from nights in watching boxsets to nights out on the tiles.... and even their taste in men. The pair also bond over their shared appreciation for all things Bono and Barry from Eastenders. In the Weekly Whine Club, we learn why having a Victoria Secret’s model as a wife may not be as glamorous as it sounds and, rather ironically, that poor punctuality is one of Abbey’s pet hates. In Agony Ab, we go international and provide assistance to some of our Spanish listeners and Pete gives tips on how to keep to spice alive (spoiler: it does not involve dressing up as a viking)

programme.title: The Sidwell’s: Steve and Krysy Sidwell on Marriage, Teenage Tear-Ups and Book Club Blunders
programme.desc: On today’s episode of The Therapy Crouch, Abbey and Peter are joined by some of their oldest and closest friends - Steve and Krysy Sidwell. In a friendship spanning two decades which has seen the couples share career paths, holidays and some outrageous nights out, this podcast is full of laughs and a behind the curtain, sneak peak into what it’s like being best friends with your favourite pair of podcasters! Steve and Krysy discuss what they think has made their 20 year marriage stay rock solid after all these years and how they are navigating having three teenage boys who have developed of penchant for knocking seven bells of sh*t out of each other on a regular basis. In the Agony Ab section, we hear from a listener who has some concerns about his wife’s recent fashion choices as well what to do in the awkward situation when someone likes you more than you like them - so stay tuned for that!! Enjoy this week’s Therapy Crouch!

programme.title: Louise Redknapp On Coping With Loneliness And Low Self-Esteem
programme.desc: Singer Louise Redknapp discusses feeling pressure to be the 'good girl' after years in a 90s girlband and marriage to a sports star, which left her afraid of saying or doing the wrong thing. She explores how not knowing her dad and becoming a mother have impacted her confidence and identity, and shares how she's learning to trust her own gut instinct and embrace different facets of her character.

programme.title: Kate Winslet: Why I’m Embracing Wrinkles And Championing Women
programme.desc: Grief can make you feel unnervingly vulnerable; this is how Kate Winslet reflects on losing her mum in 2017. In this chat, Fearne and Kate share their own experiences of both grieving and co-parenting at Christmas. Regularly labelled as "fat" by the media, Kate explains what effect that scrutiny had on her self-esteem, and why it's made her even more passionate about setting an example to younger women by ageing naturally.

programme.title: Jesy Nelson On Finding Herself And Feeling Free After Leaving Little Mix
programme.desc: As part of Little Mix, Jesy Nelson felt constantly compared to her bandmates and struggled with the pressure of being in a girl band, leading to self-esteem problems and depression. She discusses with Fearne how appearance mattered as much as talent in the music industry.

programme.title: Brian Cox On Finding Purpose In A Vast Universe
programme.desc: What can the universe teach us about being human? Physicist Professor Brian Cox discusses getting comfortable with being wrong, the difference between having an argument and making an argument, and how curiosity and doubt are essential to learning and happiness. He explores why ego blocks human progress, how democracy depends on doubt, the beauty of curiosity, the randomness of life, and our greatest moral responsibility in protecting the planet.

programme.title: Leah Williamson On Bouncing Back From A Footballer's Worst Nightmare
programme.desc: Footballer Leah Williamson discusses how getting through a major injury has made her love the person she is now more than the one she was before because of the way she looks after herself. Leah talks about the importance of listening to your own body, and trusting what it's trying to tell you rather than ignoring or overriding it.

programme.title: How Coleen And Wayne Rooney Make Their Marriage Work
programme.desc: Coleen Rooney discusses how she and husband Wayne prioritise honesty, family and their relationship after many years together. She explains how she's instilling honesty in her four sons and the importance of having a village to help raise her boys. Coleen also discusses school gate WhatsApp group dynamics, dealing with stress, and what it was like being thrust into the public eye as a teenager when her boyfriend became a footballer.

programme.title: Chloe Ashby On Holiday Romances & Friendship In Your 40s
programme.desc: For 20 years Maggie and Will have spent idyllic summers in the south of France with their friends Lydia and Roland. This year, tension is brewing and loyalties are being tested. Their young kids are all there too, and they might stumble upon secrets that were being kept from them. Author Chloe Ashby discusses her novel Family Friends with Fearne Cotton, exploring relationship dynamics around the age of 40.

programme.title: Gary and Emma Neville: Early Menopause Changed Us Forever
programme.desc: Fearne sits down with Gary and Emma Neville to talk about love, their life together, and the challenges they've faced together. Emma shares her experience of going through menopause in her 40s, and how it has impacted her both physically and emotionally.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E07 - S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: In 1968, a new form of military policing was being developed in a rural area north of Los Angeles. The Los Angeles Police Department sent an observer to this unit, and he, in turn, took this knowledge back to the LAPD. This contributed to the development of the department’s first Special Weapons and Tactics (S.W.A.T.) team. This CQB episode takes an historical journey to examine how this incident affected and changed police tactics around the world. Using CQB’s trademark “sub-second” analysis, the program also looks at how police S.W.A.T. teams train, plan and equip themselves for the challenges of urban combat. The dramatization of a 1980s S.W.A.T. siege of a gang safe-house demonstrates the complicated challenge of protecting innocent people who might be caught in the line of fi re, as well as the specifics of the squad’s training regimen, how they communicated, and the special equipment they used.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E08 - Hunting Sarajevo Snipers
programme.desc: The Bosnian War was an extraordinarily complex event, with many layers of military involvement including NATO forces, national militaries, irregular paramilitary forces, mujahedeen revolutionaries, private security companies, and international intelligence personnel. One tactic in particular struck fear into the hearts of the military and civilians alike: the use of snipers positioned in high buildings. This edition of CQB investigates this specific combat technique and how it was countered by opposing forces. Taking viewers inside a “sniper‘s den,” the program explains how this tactic was so successfully used by rebel forces – and how traditional military techniques evolved to combat it.

programme.title: glCuba - Brilliantly Caribbean
programme.desc: Even anyone who has not yet been to Cuba can conjure up certain images of American vintage street cruisers, imposing buildings that have seen better days, white sandy beaches full of palms and loving couples on the Malecón against a backdrop of crashing waves. This island is somewhat of a myth and its people generate a special joie de vivre. The legendary Hershey Train departs for Matanzas from the capital, Havana. On the oldest electrified railway line in the Caribbean, 60-year-old Spanish carriages make their way along al-most 100 kilometres of coastline in the most relaxed way possible. The Salvavidas on Varadero, probably the most famous beach on the island, have a particular-ly beautiful workplace. The lifeguards' territory ex-tends for more than 20 kilometres. In order to protect the coasts of Cuba, mangroves have been replanted here for many years. The project is supported by the UN and planting is often carried out by schoolchildren. In doing so, Cuban children learn how to treat their maritime habitat in a sustainable fashion. The former colonial city of Trinidad on Cuba's south coast is gen-erally considered to be one of the most beautiful places in the entire Caribbean. The houses here are particular-ly colourful. A plethora of magnificent buildings can be seen at the Plaza Mayor, the neo-baroque main square.

programme.title: mareTV: The Eckernförde Bay - Beach shooters, mine clearance divers, squirrels
programme.desc: Fjord, ford, bay, gulf: there are many names for the beautiful extensions of the Baltic Sea into the country. Eckernförde Bay is shaped by currents, surf and people. It stretches 17 kilometers to the town that gives it its name. Stephan Möller is the acting shooting master of the Eckernförder Bürgerschützengilde. He spent a whole year preparing the beach shooting festival and then this: fog, rain and a stiff breeze. Traditionally, the Eckernförde marksmen always shoot at a wooden bird in the direction of the sea at Whitsun. Under strict conditions! And these stipulate a clear view of at least one kilometer out into the bay. The event literally threatens to fall through, for the first time in 449 years. Around 3,000 soldiers are stationed at the Eckernförde naval base, but only a small group is allowed to call itself an elite unit: the mine divers. They are considered the toughest soldiers in the Navy. Anyone who wants to be one of them has to undergo extreme training. This year, just two candidates made it to the final round. Now they still have to pass the dreaded final exam: running 20 kilometers with marching gear and then swimming ten kilometers through Eckernförde Bay.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The Parque Nacional Peneda-Gerês is the only national park in Portugal. An area of almost 700 square kilometers, located in the extreme north of Portugal. Barren and rocky ridges in the plateaus, contrast with large forests and lush ground vegetation in deep valleys, crossed by lakes and rivers. The park is known for its oak forests, which are predominantly pedunculate and Pyrenean oaks. Among the typical animals of the park are the small Garrano ponies, a very old breed of horse and the only one in Europe that still lives in the wild.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The highest mountain range in Portugal is the Serra da Estrela. The episode embarks on a voyage of discovery to adventurous rock formations and villages steeped in tradition. The nature park is the largest protected area on the Iberian peninsula. In the mountain range we accompany the young scientist Ana Matos, who wants to breathe new life into old traditions, and cheese maker Maria Natália Lopes. She watches over more than 350 sheeps.

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Lee Jin ah episode 236
programme.desc: I'm LIVE presents three special episodes in commemoration of the end of the year and having a live audience for the first time in 2 years! The trilogy is composed of Christmas Special Year-End Special and New-Year Special and the guest of the Christmas Special Episode is Lee Jin ah. Lee Jin ah is a pop/jazz singer-songwriter known for her exceptional piano playing and composition capabilities. Her jazz-based music covering pop R&B hip-hop ballads and more has long been supported with enthusiasm by the public and also by fellow musicians and she always comforts the hearts of listeners with her genuine heartfelt message. In an effort to widen her artistry she made her debut as a film music director in May this year she made her debut as a film music director with Kids Are Fine. In this Christmas special edition Lee Jin ah performs The Wall Blocks Me Noisily Everywhere Awake Yum Yum Yum and her own version of Santa Claus Is Coming To Town. I'm LIVE allows musicians and fans to interact up-close within a distance of 1 meter. Numerous big names and rookies in the Korean music scene including Jannabi 10CM HYUKOH SE SO NEON CNBLUE Jeongmilla BIBI NIve and Lydia Lee have participated in the show. Also only those who have been fully vaccinated (defined as more than 14 days after the final vaccine dose) can participate in the live recording as an audience.

Kwon Jin ah is known for her tranquil and heartwarming voice that genuinely comforts our hearts. programme.title: I morgon börjar allt

programme.title: Mannen utan minne
programme.desc: Aki Kaurismäkis film om en man som tappar sitt minne och får hjälp av fattiga men storhjärtade människor i en containerby.

programme.title: La vie en rose - Berättelsen om Edith Piaf
programme.desc: Edith Piafs liv var kantat av såväl tragedier som triumfer. I La vie en rose skildras hennes liv från en miserabel barndom till nationalikon genom kärlek, sorg och beroende.

programme.title: Carol
programme.desc: Therese Belivet jobbar i ett av Manhattans varuhus, men hon drömmer om ett mer meningsfullt liv. En dag träffar hon Carol Aird - en förförisk kvinna fast i ett misslyckat äktenskap. En gnista tänds mellan dem, och ju djupare deras relation blir, desto mindre oskyldig blir den.
